query: BEGIN; SELECT set_config('test.student_a',(SELECT id::text FROM public.profiles WHERE role='student' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),true); SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',current_setting('test.student_a'),true); SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; CREATE TEMP TABLE rls_result(owner_visible integer) ON COMMIT DROP; INSERT INTO public.edutech_grades(student_id,subject_offering_id,subject_label_legacy,school_year,term,assessment_type,grade,max_grade,assessment_date,comment,include_in_average,created_by_student) SELECT auth.uid(),o.id,s.name,'2026-2027','T1','devoir_classe',10,20,'2026-01-15','Test transactionnel RLS à supprimer',true,true FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.levels l ON l.name=p.school_level JOIN public.series sr ON sr.name=p.series JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id=l.id AND o.series_id=sr.id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id WHERE p.id=auth.uid() LIMIT 1; INSERT INTO rls_result SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_grades WHERE comment='Test transactionnel RLS à supprimer'; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',true); SELECT (SELECT owner_visible FROM rls_result LIMIT 1) AS visible_to_owner, count(*) AS visible_to_second_identity FROM public.edutech_grades WHERE comment='Test transactionnel RLS à supprimer'; ROLLBACK;
